style_notes: Late delivery penalty: write the delivery date once, in the delivery clause, and do not define a term for it. In the penalty clause refer to it only by a cross-reference such as "the date stated in clause 5.2" (use the real clause number).
extra_decoys: If the Buyer cancels a confirmed order within five (5) days before the scheduled delivery, a cancellation charge of 4% of the order value is payable by the Buyer.
